what_it_is:
SABLE is an expandable posterior lumbar  interbody spacer with 3D printed titanium endplates. After insertion and expansion, the cage can be backfilled via a funnel placed in-situ down the inserter.
Lordotic options available:
- 8, 15, 22o options
Expansion Heights from:
- 6-18mm
